uplink.description: TX TEMP CONT2 600-232 (EN306, type 0x0C): probe0 20.2 °C, probe1 38.6 °C, battery 25%
uplink._note: TTN example input. Upstream oracle: values.temperature_1 20.2 °C, values.temperature_2 38.6 °C, states.battery '25%', id 189, seq_counter 10. Each PT1000 probe is now a channels[] entry carrying `temperature`; batteryPercent / deviceId / sequenceCounter stay top-level. Satisfies temperature.

uplink.description: Both probes with distinct readings across zero: probe0 -5.3 °C, probe1 100.0 °C, battery 100%
uplink._note: Synthetic EN306 frame exercising both positions with a negative probe 1: bytes[6..7]=0xFFCB=-53 -> -5.3 °C; bytes[8..9]=0x03E8=1000 -> 100.0 °C; state word bytes[12..13]=0x0000 -> battery code 00 = 100%. No probe word is a sentinel in this format, so both entries are always emitted.
